maya: Heads-up — onboarding Spectra's LoRA merge for their customer_facing_finetune. Did a quick smoke pack; seeing numeric drift on billing/invoice examples.
alan: Can you paste the exact failing prompt/output? :eyes:
maya: Sure — prompt snippet:
```
Invoice total: "Please sum items"
Items: ["$10", "$2.50", "$0.99"]
```
Model returned: "Total: $12.49" (expected $13.49) — looks like one item dropped/rounded.
monica: That smells like tokenization splitting or a scaling shift after quant+LoRA merge. Which base/quant did you run on?
maya: Ran merge against mantic-2-7b-int4 with spectra-lora.safetensors applied.
alan: Did you run tokenizer mapping and verify no special tokens introduced by the adapter?
maya: Token map looked fine; currency tokens stay intact. Also observed subtle KV cache mismatch when context > 512 tokens.
ryan: I can repro locally with the same merged weights. Running a head-activation trace now.
monica: If it's a head-scale issue the usual fixes are: recompute LoRA scale on merge, or apply zero_bias_fix. Try recompute first.
monica: ```bash
python tools/merge_lora.py --recompute-scale --base mantic-2-7b --lora spectra-lora.safetensors --out merged_recompute.safetensors\```
maya: Kicked off recompute job. Also queued quick-eval pack (12 tests) targeting billing, date parsing, and numeric aggregation.
eval-bot: quick-eval-pack started: id=qe-1729001234, tests=12, timeout=10m. Will post results here.
ryan: If recompute doesn't fix, try merging with --zeroed_bias_fix and compare logits on the invoice tokens.
maya: Recompute finished — attaching short run: eval-bot reported 12 tests, 3 fails before, retest on merged_recompute.safetensors running now.
eval-bot: recompute run complete: 12 tests run, 0 failed. Invoice total test corrected. Diff summary:
- invoice_test: previous answer $12.49 -> now $13.49
- long_context_token_loss: reduced by 0.7%
- date_parsing: unchanged

eval-bot: logs: https://internal.redwood/spectra/eval/1729001234 (internal)
maya: Great — plan: canary deploy merged_recompute.safetensors to Dedicated Spectra pool (10% traffic), monitor the billing prompt set and token-level diffs for 24h, then ramp.
alan: Add a regression alert in Console for the billing prompt set and set threshold for numeric delta > $0.1.
monica: I'll open a short PR with the merge commands, the recompute flags, and CI test additions.
ryan: Leaving a note to instrument head activations for future merges so we catch scaling drift earlier.
maya: Thanks all — I'll message Spectra with the quick-eval deck: https://internal.redwood/spectra/quick-eval/1729001234 and follow up on rollout docs. Closing this thread once PR is up.
